title: A five sentence term paper using chi2 analysis
text:
Introduction
RQ: Does the color of the book predict the books genre
This paper explores whether there is a connection between the color of a book and its genre.


Literature Review
Book Genre Prediction Using NLP: A Review (Vayadande et al. 2024)


Method

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import seaborn as sns

from scipy.stats import chi2_contingency

domain = 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/'
path = "adamrossnelson/confident/refs/heads/main/data/"
file = "confident_fictional_books.csv"

books = pd.read_csv(domain + path + file)

Our null hypothesis it doesn’t predict genre. We study this with 359 books where we know the books genre and the books cover color such that we can conduct a chi2 test to see if these two variables are either independe3nt to dependent 6 6


Results

# Conduct the chi2 with chi2_contingency by passing the observed
x2, pval, degf, _ = chi2_contingency(
    pd.crosstab(books['book_genre'], books['book_color']))

Results: Chi2 stat: 1.9921 - Pvalue: 0.9999999998 - degrees of freedom: 25.


Discussion
Unfortunately, you cannot predict the genre of a book based on the color of it.


References


Vayadande, Kuldeep, Preeti Bailke, Ashutosh M Kulkarni, R Kumar, and Ajit B Patil. 2024. “Book Genre Prediction Using NLP: A Review.” How Machine Learning Is Innovating Today’s World: A Concise Technical Guide, 37–46.
